content: Verified via three 0.185.1 package.json exports map: addons and addons wildcard alias to examples/jsm/Addons.js and examples/jsm wildcard respectively, both paths resolve identically today. three/addons is the forward-facing recommended alias; three/examples/jsm still works as legacy-equivalent. OrbitControls, EffectComposer, ShaderPass all ship in-tree under examples/jsm, no separate install needed.
